feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 19 August 2026 6:07pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 19 August 2026 at 4:50pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure moving into Ireland tracking southeast as various fronts and troughs affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

West or southwest 3 or 4, occasionally 5 at first, veering northwest this evening, then veering north or northeast 4 or 5 overnight and occasionally 6 in places. Backing north or northwest later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate overnight.


##Weather##

Showers that may merge into longer spells of rain at times and potentially heavy.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

North or northwest 4 or 5, occasionally 6 at first, soon falling 3 in places in the east. Decreasing 2 to 4 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Slight, occasionally moderate at first.


##Weather##

Occasional showers.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in showers.
